messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - autoscaler.queue_overrun (P0) - 6301234567 - https://pd.example/incident/ABC123
pagerduty: Auto-assign to on-call (Alex). page status: fired -> triggered.
Alex: I'm on it, acking. Triage in #eng-oncall.
Alex: Quick check - any visible customer errors? Maria, can you pull the external error rate?
Maria: looking now. 5xx rate spiked ~1.2% in the last 3m, most from inference endpoints /v1/generate. Latency for queued requests jumping to 20s.
Sahil: I see queue depth in the dispatcher metrics: queue_depth per-cell: [cell-a: 1200, cell-b: 980, cell-c: 300]. Autoscaler target add rate is zero.
Jin: Graph snippet from metrics: ```
# timeseries sample
queue_depth{cell="cell-a"} 1200
autoscaler.pending_nodes 0
cloud.api.provision_errors 3
```
Priya: Looks like node provisioning is failing. I see provider error: `QuotaExceeded: Insufficient compute quota in region us-west-2` in the cloud API logs.
Sahil: confirmed. Autoscaler requested nodes but provider returned 403/QuotaExceeded, so controller backed off.
Alex: Ok plan: (1) manual scale override to relieve hot queues, (2) open quick support ticket with cloud to raise quota, (3) re-evaluate autoscaler backoff settings. Executing (1) now.
Priya: Running emergency scale: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment cell-a-workers --replicas=30
kubectl -n inference scale deployment cell-b-workers --replicas=25
```
Priya: Scale command returned OK, but pods stuck Pending with reason `Insufficient resources`. Cloud still rejecting.
Sahil: Can we temporarily shift some workloads to warm spare pool in us-east-1? That region has available quota.
Alex: Yes. I'll flip routing for low-priority/async inference to warm-spare pool. Executing traffic policy change.
Jin: Routing change applied: /v1/generate for non-SLA clients -> warm-spare-us-east. Confirming traffic is draining from cell-a.
Maria: Error rate for public customers dropped from 1.2% -> 0.6 after routing change. Latency for queued requests still high for the last 5m but trending down.
Priya: Cloud support responded: provisional quota increased by 20 for GPU instances, ETA ~18m. They asked for account ID and recent activity logs (I've sent).
Sahil: While we wait, disabling autoscaler backoff for hotpath to allow retry: ```
# patch autoscaler config
kubectl -n infra patch configmap autoscaler-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"backoff_enabled":"false"}}'
```
Alex: Done. Autoscaler now retrying. New provision requests observed.
Jin: Metrics update: queue_depth cell-a -> 650, cell-b -> 420, pending_nodes -> 16, provision_errors -> 0.
Maria: External 5xx rate now 0.3%, request latency for queued calls median down to 3.1s.
Priya: Cloud confirmed quota is active. New nodes are provisioning and joining.
Alex: Good. I'm going to stabilize and then hand off once queue_depth < 200 across cells and error rate back to baseline. Current ETA ~12m.
Sahil: Filing a follow-up GH issue to investigate autoscaler backoff thresholds + add quota-check alert to runbook.
Jin: Creating short post-incident note in #postmortems with timeline.
Alex: Okay oncall handoff in 20m. I'll monitor for 30m after handoff. If anything spikes, escalate to infra pager.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged and marked as resolved by on-call in PD after mitigation.
Alex: handing to Priya for watch. Priya, please escalate to infra if provisioning errors reappear.
Priya: Ack. Monitoring for 30m.
Alex: Closing thread here — follow-ups: 1) autoscaler backoff tuning (Sahil) 2) add quota-detection alert (Jin) 3) runbook update (Maria).
Priya: :thumbsup: will open the tickets.
Jin: Thanks team.
Alex: End of thread.
